scope: Pinned developer-preview runtime and fixture qualification; not customer deployment or provider certification.

smoke.scope: Dedicated service on a shared test VM; synthetic Parquet/CSV file federation, small durable exports and lifecycle, not live database/object providers, WAN or multi-host capacity
smoke.latency_scope: Client elapsed times and dispatch observation upper bounds (50ms polling), not exact distributed queue attribution; node admission histograms exclude dispatch.

process_sampling.scope: Owned application parents and observed descendants; excludes brokers/Python. Stat RSS uses approximate per-CPU resident counters, can miss short peaks and double-count shared mappings, and is not directly comparable to status VmRSS. Dedicated service cgroup memory.peak is the whole-fixture charged-memory peak.

sustained.scope: Dedicated service on a shared test VM; synthetic Parquet/CSV file federation, small durable exports and lifecycle, not live database/object providers, WAN or multi-host capacity
sustained.latency_scope: Client elapsed times and dispatch observation upper bounds (50ms polling), not exact distributed queue attribution; node admission histograms exclude dispatch.

retained_failures.status: The historical cause remains unknown; earlier diagnostics did not retain it. New fixed classifications and isolated fencing/recovery tests do not establish that historical cause.

retained_failures.failure: Workload gates passed but cleanup counted the permanent custody metadata/root as retained exports.
retained_failures.resolution: Inspect the strict custody layout and count actual entries inside data/. No payload deletion or cleanup relaxation.

limits: Paced synthetic single-host Parquet/CSV federation; no maximum-throughput result.
Nine-row durable exports verify lifecycle and repeat reads, not wide-export capacity.
Normal clients quiesce briefly for fault assertions that establish their own running and queued work.
The service cap and charged peak include brokers and the Python controller; sampled application RSS has a different scope.
No live warehouse/object-provider, WAN, Oracle micro-VM repeat, mixed-version rollout or customer recovery qualification.
Native AMD64 runtime with duckdb_arrow; separate CI covers the optional duckbridge path. ARM bridge cross-build and local runtime acceptance are separate.
